name: Warframe
notes: Verified 2026-11-07 on M4 16 GB: in-game, ~90 FPS steady on LOW graphics, ~37 FPS on MEDIUM. Started directly in DX11 via DXVK-macOS (its launcher renders blank under Wine). The game first demanded an update: run Scripts/setup-warframe-launcher.sh then `stirredctl run warframe --via-steam` once so the launcher updates, close it, then play with the direct launch.
